detail.longDescription: Howdy folks! I just stumbled across a post[0] on Reddit, in which a user asked an AI model to promote his vibecoding project. The agent submitted links to a bunch of sites, and the top site was HN with 1.5k views. Color me surprised, as I've seen an explosion of LLM-content on other more popular platforms, but HN has usually been better than most. How do we deal with this in the future? Is flagging enough?[1] [0]https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49665756 [1]I believe I found the post, which was already flagged when I discovered it, but I'll refrain from sharing here.
